data.one_liner: A Flutter plugin to check if the iOS display is zoomed or set to default.
data.what_it_does: Provides a simple method to check whether an iOS device's display zoom feature is enabled. It exposes an asynchronous function to return a boolean value representing the display status.
use_when: You need to detect if iOS display zoom is active to adjust UI layouts.
Building platform-specific adaptations for iOS display scaling.
avoid_when: You are working on non-iOS platforms where this feature is not supported.
You need general device information that is already covered by broader packages.
strengths: Solves a specific iOS display detection task.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml and use it directly.

alternatives.name: device_info_plus
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides comprehensive device and system information for all platforms, though specific zoom checking depends on what is exposed.
